notes.title: New Game
notes.content:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/801840/Psychoballs/

My mind-boggling puzzle/action game Psychoballs is [strike]coming to Steam soon[/strike] out now. 

The game is a mix of RTS- and Puzzle-Game-Mechanics, so if that sounds interesting to you, make sure to put the game on your wishlist.
